title: Endpoints za uthibitishaji
description: Rejea ya /api/auth — usajili, kuingia, OTP, kuweka upya nenosiri na wasifu.
text: Endpoints zote za uthibitishaji ziko chini ya /api/auth. POST /auth/signup Sajili mtumiaji mpya. Inatuma OTP kwa barua pepe/simu iliyotolewa. json { "email": "you@example.com", "password": "secret", "fullName": "Jane Doe", "phoneNumber": "+255700000000", "role": "client" } Sehemu Inahitajika Maelezo ------- ---------- ------- email Ndiyo Barua pepe sahihi password Ndiyo Angalau herufi 6 fullName Ndiyo Jina kamili phoneNumber Ndiyo Kwa ajili ya OTP role Hapana client ni chaguo-msingi; vendor/service provider huanza wakiwa inasubiri POST /auth/login Kuingia kwa barua pepe + nenosiri. Inarudisha data.token. POST /auth/otp/verify json { "code": "123456", "email": "you@example.com", "phoneNumber": "+255700000000" } Inarudisha JWT wakati msimbo utakapothibitishwa. GET /auth/me GET wasifu wa mtumiaji wa sasa ukijumuisha businessProfile na anwani ya msingi. Uthibitishaji unahitajika. Kurejesha nenosiri Endpoint Body Madhumuni ---------- ------ --------- POST /auth/forgot-password/send { "email" } Tuma OTP ya kuweka upya POST /auth/forgot-password/verify { "code", "email" } Thibitisha msimbo wa kuweka upya POST /auth/forgot-password/reset { "email", "code", "password" } Weka nenosiri jipya Kuingia kwa Google POST /auth/google ukitumia { "idToken" } kutoka kwa mteja wa Google OAuth. Inarudisha JWT. Endpoints nyingine Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- POST /auth/otp/send — Tuma OTP ya uthibitishaji POST /auth/otp/link JWT Unganisha simu na akaunti POST /auth/otp/change-phone/send JWT Tuma OTP ya kubadilisha nambari ya simu iliyounganishwa POST /auth/otp/change-phone/verify JWT Thibitisha OTP na ubadili nambari ya simu iliyounganishwa POST /auth/google — Ingia kwa kutumia tokeni ya Google ID POST /auth/check-exists — Angalia kama barua pepe/simu tayari zipo POST /auth/logout JWT Batilisha kipindi cha sasa (session) GET /auth/refresh — Pata JWT mpya kwa kipindi sahili Mabadiliko ya nenosiri yanahudumiwa nje ya /api/auth: PUT /user/password (nenosiri la sasa + nenosiri jipya). <Callout type="note" Endpoints fulani za pekee (kama kuingia kama mtumiaji mwingine) zimehifadhiwa kwa wasimamizi wa jukwaa na hazijatolewa hadharani. </Callout

title: Mikataba ya API
description: URL ya msingi, bahasha za majibu, muundo wa hitilafu, pagination na mifumo ya kawaida.
text: Kila endpoint kwenye rejea hii inafuata mikataba hiyo hiyo. URL ya msingi text https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api Bahasha ya majibu Majibu yenye mafanikio hutumia bahasha moja thabiti: <CodeBlock title="Success shape" json { "status": "success", "data": { ... } } </CodeBlock Baadhi ya endpoints hurudisha safu (array) ya kiwango cha juu au kitu bapa; angalia mfano wa kila endpoint. Muundo wa hitilafu Hitilafu daima hurudisha hali ya 4xx/5xx pamoja na: <CodeBlock title="Error shape" json { "status": "error", "message": "Human-readable explanation", "code": "OPTIONAL MACHINE CODE" } </CodeBlock Hali Maana -------- --------- 400 Ombi baya / uthibitisho umeshindwa 401 Tokeni haipo au si sahihi 403 Jukumu haliruhusiwi 404 Rasilimali haikupatikana 429 Kikomo cha maombi (rate limit) kimefikiwa 503 Kipengele kimezimwa (feature guard) Pagination Endpoints za orodha hukubali vigezo vya page na limit vya query na hurudisha data iliyogawanywa kwa kurasa, kwa mfano: <CodeBlock title="Paginated shape" json { "status": "success", "data": { "items": [], "page": 1, "limit": 20, "total": 143, "totalPages": 8 } } </CodeBlock Kuchuja na kutafuta Endpoints nyingi za orodha hutumia vichujio vya search, category, sort na vingine kupitia vigezo vya query. Endpoint ya utafutaji wa jumla hutoa utafutaji unaovuka huluki nyingi (cross-entity). Kufuta kwa upole (soft delete) Rasilimali zilizowekwa alama ya deletedAt zimefutwa kwa upole: hazionekani kwenye queries za kawaida lakini zinabaki kwenye hifadhidata hadi msimamizi atakapozifuta kabisa. Tarehe na saa Mihuri yote ya wakati inarudishwa kama mifuatano ya ISO 8601 ya UTC.

title: Mauzo ya flash
description: Rejea ya /api/flash-sales — mauzo yanayoendelea, ushiriki wa muuzaji na usimamizi wa superAdmin.
text: Mauzo ya flash huwapa bidhaa bei zilizopunguzwa kwa dirisha fupi la wakati. Wauzaji huwasilisha bidhaa kwa ushiriki, na superAdmin lazima aidhinishe kabla bidhaa haijapunguziwa bei. Muundo wa flash sale Sehemu Aina Maelezo ------- ------ ------- id string UUID name string Jina la mauzo description string? Maelezo ya hiari discountPercent int Lazima iwe kati ya 1 na 90 startsAt string ISO 8601, wakati dirisha linafunguka expiresAt string ISO 8601, wakati dirisha linafunguka kufungwa isActive bool Chaguo-msingi true products json? Payload ya bidhaa ya hiari deletedAt string? Inawekwa wakati wa kufuta kwa upole Mzunguko wa hali ya mshiriki Kila ushiriki una status: pending → approved rejected join ya muuzaji inaunda mshiriki mwenye hali pending. Kisha superAdmin anamwidhinisha au kumkataa; ni washiriki wenye approved pekee wanaoonekana kwa bei iliyopunguzwa. Endpoints Method Path Uthibitishaji Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /flash-sales/active Hadharani Mauzo ya flash yanayoendelea POST /flash-sales/join/:flashSaleId vendor Wasilisha bidhaa kwa flash sale GET /flash-sales/admin/list superAdmin Orodhesha mauzo ya flash POST /flash-sales/admin/create superAdmin Unda flash sale PATCH /flash-sales/admin/:id superAdmin Sasisha flash sale DELETE /flash-sales/admin/:id superAdmin Futa flash sale kwa upole PATCH /flash-sales/admin/participant/:id/approve superAdmin Idhinisha mshiriki PATCH /flash-sales/admin/participant/:id/reject superAdmin Kataa mshiriki GET /flash-sales/active Hadharani. Inarudisha mauzo yaliyo wazi, yasiyofutwa na yaliyo ndani ya dirisha lake la sasa (startsAt ≤ sasa ≤ expiresAt), yaliyopangwa kwa kumalizika kwa karibu zaidi. Kila mauzo yanajumuisha participantsCount. <CodeBlock title="Jibu" json [ { "id": "...", "name": "Back to School", "description": "School supplies at a discount", "discountPercent": 25, "startsAt": "2026-08-07T00:00:00.000Z", "expiresAt": "2026-08-09T23:59:59.000Z", "isActive": true, "products": null, "participantsCount": 4 } ] </CodeBlock POST /flash-sales/join/:flashSaleId Muuzaji anawasilisha bidhaa yake moja. Body: json { "productId": "..." } productId inahitajika. Inarudisha 201 pamoja na mshiriki mpya mwenye hali pending. Hali Hali inayofaa -------- ----------- 400 Hakuna productId, mauzo si ya sasa, bidhaa tayari imewasilishwa, au kikomo cha ushiriki cha kiwango kimefikiwa 403 Bidhaa si ya biashara ya muuzaji 404 Flash sale au bidhaa haikupatikana 503 Kipengele flash sales kimezimwa Ushiriki una kikomo kwa kiwango cha usajili wa muuzaji, ukihesabu washiriki wenye pending + approved: Kiwango Upeo wa ushiriki unaoendelea ------ --------------------------- free 1 pro 3 business 5 enterprise 10 <Callout type="note" Kujiunga na flash sale kunaunda tu ushiriki wa pending — superAdmin lazima auidhinishe kabla bidhaa haijajumuishwa kwenye mauzo. </Callout Endpoints za usimamizi POST /flash-sales/admin/create Body: json { "name": "Back to School", "description": "School supplies at a discount", "discountPercent": 25, "startsAt": "2026-08-07T00:00:00.000Z", "expiresAt": "2026-08-09T23:59:59.000Z" } name, discountPercent, startsAt na expiresAt zinahitajika. discountPercent lazima iwe kati ya 1 na 90 na expiresAt lazima iwe baada ya startsAt. Inarudisha 201 pamoja na mauzo yaliyoundwa. GET /flash-sales/admin/list Orodhesha mauzo kwa pagination ya page/limit. Chuja kwa status: status Inarudisha ---------- --------- active Mauzo yanayoendelea sasa upcoming Mauzo ambayo hayajaanza expired Mauzo yaliyopita expiresAt inactive Mauzo yenye isActive: false (imeachwa) Mauzo yote yasiyofutwa <CodeBlock title="Jibu" json { "flashSales": [ { "id": "...", "name": "Back to School", " count": { "participants": 4 } } ], "pagination": { "page": 1, "limit": 20, "total": 1, "totalPages": 1 } } </CodeBlock PATCH /flash-sales/admin/:id Inasasisha mauzo kwa sehemu. Yoyote kati ya name, description, discountPercent, startsAt, expiresAt, isActive (inakubali boolean au mfuatano wa "true"/"false"). Inarudisha 404 ikiwa mauzo hayapo au yamefutwa. DELETE /flash-sales/admin/:id Inafuta mauzo kwa upole (inaweka deletedAt/deletedBy; data inahifadhiwa). Inarudisha 404 ikiwa hayajapatikana au tayari yamefutwa. PATCH /flash-sales/admin/participant/:id/approve Inaidhinisha mshiriki mwenye pending. Inarudisha 400 ikiwa mshiriki si wa pending, 404 ikiwa hapatikani. PATCH /flash-sales/admin/participant/:id/reject Inamkataa mshiriki mwenye pending. Tabia ya makosa ni sawa na approve.

title: Arifa na ujumbe
description: Rejea ya /api/notifications, /api/messages, /api/content na endpoints za msaada.
text: Endpoints hizi zinashughulikia mawasiliano baina ya watumiaji na maudhui ya jukwaa. Arifa (/api/notifications) Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /notifications JWT Arifa zako PUT /notifications/:id/read JWT Weka alama ya kusoma kwa arifa moja PUT /notifications/read-all JWT Weka alama ya kusoma zote DELETE /notifications/clear JWT Futa zote POST /notifications/register-token JWT Sajili usajili wa web-push PUT /notifications/update-expo-token JWT Sasisha tokeni ya push ya Expo GET /notifications/preferences JWT Pata mapendeleo PUT /notifications/preferences JWT Sasisha mapendeleo POST /notifications/notify-all admin Arifu kila mtu POST /notifications/notify-vendor admin Arifu wauzaji Mapendeleo: order updates, promotions, general. Ujumbe (/api/messages) Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- POST /messages JWT Tuma ujumbe GET /messages/conversations JWT Mazungumzo + idadi ya ujumbe usiosomwa GET /messages/:userId JWT Mjadala na mtumiaji PUT /messages/:id/read JWT Weka alama ya kusoma kwa ujumbe mmoja PUT /messages/read/:userId JWT Weka alama ya kusoma ujumbe wote wa mtumiaji GET /messages/unread/count JWT Jumla ya ujumbe usiosomwa Maudhui na msaada (/api/content) Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /content/platform/:key Public Ukurasa wa CMS (faragha, sheria) PUT /content/platform/:key superAdmin Unda au sasisha ukurasa wa CMS GET /content/faq Public FAQs zinazotumika GET /content/faq/all partnerAdmin+ FAQs zote POST/PUT/DELETE /content/faq... partnerAdmin+ CRUD ya FAQ POST /content/support/tickets JWT Unda tikiti GET /content/support/tickets JWT Tikiti zako GET /content/support/tickets/all partnerAdmin+ Tikiti zote PUT /content/support/tickets/:id partnerAdmin+ Sasisha hali POST /content/support/tickets/:id/reply partnerAdmin+ Jibu Mawasiliano mengine Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- POST /feedback client Maoni ya agizo GET /feedback Public Maoni yaliyoidhinishwa + takwimu POST /reviews client Unda tathmini GET /reviews Public Tathmini zilizoidhinishwa POST /reports JWT Tuma ripoti (bug/lalamiko/n.k.)

title: Maagizo, rukoba ya ununuzi na kuhifadhi nafasi
description: Rejea ya /api/orders, /api/cart na /api/bookings — malipo ya agizo, utekelezaji na usafirishaji.
text: Maagizo, rukoba ya ununuzi na kuhifadhi nafasi vinahusika na mzunguko wa ununuzi. Rukoba ya ununuzi (/api/cart) Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- POST /cart/add JWT Ongeza/ongeza idadi ya bidhaa GET /cart JWT Pata rukoba pamoja na maelezo ya bidhaa PATCH /cart/:id JWT Sasisha idadi DELETE /cart/:id JWT Ondoa bidhaa POST /cart/clear JWT Futa rukoba <Callout type="note" Endpoints za /api/cart kwa sasa zimezimwa (frozen) — router haujafungwa kwenye app.js (rukoba huhifadhiwa upande wa mteja). Checkout inayohitaji akaunti bado inasoma vipengee kutoka kwenye jedwali la CartItem. Angalia data model. </Callout Maagizo (/api/orders) Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- POST /orders/checkout JWT Unda agizo kutoka kwenye rukoba (COD wakati payment service ikiwa imezimwa) POST /orders/express-checkout Optional Ununuzi bila akaunti, unafuatiliwa kwa msimbo wa agizo GET /orders JWT Maagizo yako GET /orders/vendor vendor+ Maagizo yenye bidhaa zako GET /orders/:id JWT Agizo moja (mmiliki, mshirika wa usafirishaji au muuzaji) GET /orders/track/:orderCode Public Fuata agizo la mgeni kwa msimbo wa rejea POST /orders/:orderCode/pay Public Anzisha malipo ya agizo la mgeni kwa msimbo wa rejea POST /orders/:orderCode/cancel Public Ghairi agizo la mgeni kwa msimbo wa rejea (ulinzi wa simu wa hiari) PUT /orders/:id/status vendor+ Sasisha hali (suborderId ya hiari) PUT /orders/:id/verify-recipient JWT Mteja anathibitisha kupokea (suborderId ya hiari) POST /orders/verify-qr delivery/vendor/admin Thibitisha suborder kupitia payload yake ya QR PUT /orders/:id/deliver delivery/vendor+ Weka alama ya kukabidhiwa, rekodi collectedAmount (suborderId ya hiari) PUT /orders/:id/negotiate vendor+ Weka negotiatedAmount kwa suborder PUT /orders/:id/cancel JWT Ghairi (pending/confirmed pekee, inarekodi cancelReason) GET /orders/sales-report vendor Ripoti ya mauzo ya kipindi Suborders Checkout inagawanya agizo kuwa suborder moja kwa kila biashara ya muuzaji (angalia data model). Kila suborder ina status na recipientCode yake. Mutations zinazofanya kazi kwenye sehemu ya muuzaji mmoja zinakubali suborderId ya hiari ili backend ilenge suborder sahihi badala ya agizo lote: - PUT /orders/:id/status → body { "status": "confirmed", "suborderId": "..." } - PUT /orders/:id/verify-recipient → body { "recipientId": "<recipientCode ", "suborderId": "..." } - POST /orders/verify-qr → body { "orderId": "...", "suborderId": "...", "recipientId": "<recipientCode " } - PUT /orders/:id/deliver → body { "recipientId": "<recipientCode ", "suborderId": "...", "collectedAmount": 15000 } - PUT /orders/:id/negotiate → body { "negotiatedAmount": 14000, "suborderId": "..." } - POST /delivery/assign → body { "orderId": "...", "deliveryPersonId": "...", "suborderId": "..." } - PUT /delivery/:id/verify → body { "recipientId": "<recipientCode ", "suborderId": "..." } Payload ya QR ya usafirishaji inasimbua suborder kama { v:1, o:<suborderId , r:<recipientCode , s:1 } — wateja wanaoakti ni kama msimbo wa QR na endpoints za uthibitisho zinarejesha o/r kuwa suborderId + recipientId. Body ya malipo ya agizo json { "hasDelivery": true, "deliveryAddress": "Kijitonyama, Dar es Salaam", "deliveryLat": -6.79, "deliveryLng": 39.22, "deliveries": [ { "businessId": "...", "hasDelivery": true, "deliveryLocation": "Mikocheni" } ] } deliveries ni safu ya hiari ya kila biashara inayobadilisha usafirishaji kwa kila suborder. deliveryLocation lazima iwe kwenye zones za usafirishaji za biashara; vinginevyo deliveryFee ya jumla ya biashara inatumika. Malipo kwa wakati wa kukabidhi (Cash on Delivery) Wakati kipengele cha payment service kikiwa kimezimwa , malipo ya mtandaoni yamezimwa lakini kuweka maagizo na checkout zinaendelea kufanya kazi. Checkout inajibu kwa: json { "message": "Order placed successfully", "order": { ... }, "requiresPayment": false, "escrowCreated": true } - requiresPayment: false → hakuna malipo ya gateway yanayotarajiwa; agizo linawekwa kama Cash on Delivery na mshirika wa usafirishaji hukusanya wakati wa kukabidhi. - escrowCreated → rekodi ya escrow bado inaundwa (kwa default), kwa hiyo fedha zinazokusanywa wakati wa kukabidhi huhifadhiwa na kutolewa kwa kila suborder inapothibitishwa. - Wakati payment service ikiwa washa , requiresPayment: true na malipo ya gateway (ClickPesa) yanaanzishwa badala yake. - POST /orders/:orderCode/pay inarudisha { "requiresPayment": false } pamoja na taarifa ya COD wakati payment service ikiwa imezimwa. Hali za agizo pending → confirmed → shipped → delivered cancelled - Kuthibitisha suborder kunatengeneza recipientCode yake (inayotumika kwa uthibitishaji wa usafirishaji wa pande tatu na payload ya QR). - Kukabidhi suborder kunarekodi collectedAmount (kwa default negotiatedAmount ?? subtotal), inatoa sehemu ya escrow ya suborder hiyo na kumkabidhi biashara. - Kughairi (mteja au mgeni) kinaruhusiwa tu wakati agizo liko pending/confirmed; linaweka cancelReason kwenye agizo na suborders na kurudisha escrow. - returned inakubaliwa tu kupitia njia ya admin (PUT /admin/orders/:orderId/status). <Callout type="note" Maagizo ya wauzaji wengi yanatengeneza msimbo mmoja wa mpokeaji kwa kila suborder , unaothibitishwa dhidi ya sehemu ya biashara inayofanana. Safu za OrderItem zina nakala za lahaja (variantId, variantName, variantType) pamoja na selectedSpecs/notes. </Callout Usimamizi wa maagizo ya admin Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /admin/orders admin Orodhesha maagizo yote (yametengwa kwa eneo) PUT /admin/orders/:orderId/status admin+ (manage orders) Sasisha hali DELETE /admin/orders/:orderId superAdmin Futa agizo (soft delete) DELETE /admin/orders/:orderId hufanya soft delete : agizo hutiwa alama ya deletedAt/deletedBy na mara moja hutoweka kwenye kila swala la maagizo (orodha ya admin, orodha ya muuzaji, orodha ya mteja, na ufuatiliaji wa umma). Halifutwi kabisa : - Kufuta tena (au kutafuta id iliyofutwa) inarudisha 404. - Maagizo yaliyofutwa yanaonekana kwenye Rekodi Zilizofutwa (GET /admin/records) na yanaweza kurudishwa kwa POST /admin/records/Order/:orderId/restore au kuondolewa kabisa kwa DELETE /admin/records/Order/:orderId/nuke. - Historia ya escrow, bidhaa, na fedha inahifadhiwa, kwa hivyo kufuta hakuharibu rekodi za ukaguzi au malipo. - Jibu la mafanikio ni 200 lenye { "message": "Order deleted successfully", "orderId", "orderCode" }. Kuhifadhi nafasi (/api/bookings) Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- POST /bookings client Hifadhi nafasi ya huduma GET /bookings/my client Nafasi zako GET /bookings/vendor service provider Nafasi za mtoa huduma PUT /bookings/:id/accept service provider Kubali + tengeneza msimbo wa kuhifadhi nafasi PUT /bookings/:id/reject service provider Kataa POST /bookings/verify-qr service provider/admin Thibitisha QR ya kuhifadhi nafasi Usafirishaji (/api/delivery) Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- POST /delivery/create vendor+ Unda mshirika wa usafirishaji GET /delivery/my-team vendor+ Orodhesha timu POST /delivery/assign vendor+ Kabidhi suborder (→ shipped) GET /delivery/my-deliveries delivery Usafirishaji uliokabidhiwa GET /delivery/my-stats delivery Takwimu za usafirishaji PUT /delivery/:id/verify delivery Thibitisha kukabidhiwa (suborderId ya hiari) PUT /delivery/my-status delivery Badilisha hali ya Active/offline GET /delivery/calculate Public Ada ya usafirishaji kwa eneo GET /delivery/zones/public Public Zones za usafirishaji za biashara

title: Bidhaa
description: Rejea ya /api/products — orodha, CRUD, misimbo ya QR na takwimu za uchambuzi (analytics).
text: Bidhaa ni vitu halisi vinavyouzwa na wauzaji. GET /products/all Orodha ya bidhaa za umma. Query Maelezo ------- ------------- category Chuja kwa slug ya kategoria search Tafuta kwa jina/maelezo limit Idadi ya juu zaidi ya matokeo (chaguo-msingi 20) GET /products/:id Maelezo ya bidhaa moja. Inapandisha viewCount ya bidhaa. Muundo wa bidhaa (sehemu muhimu) json { "id": "...", "name": "Steel pipes 2m", "description": "...", "price": 45000, "discountPrice": 40000, "stock": 120, "unit": "piece", "imageUrl": ["https://.../image1.jpg"], "status": "published", "businessId": "...", "categoryId": "...", "viewCount": 340, "addToCartCount": 18 } Endpoints za bidhaa za muuzaji Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- POST /products/add vendor+ Unda bidhaa (picha za multipart) PUT /products/:id vendor+ Sasisha bidhaa DELETE /products/:id vendor+ Futa bidhaa kwa upole GET /products/myProducts vendor+ Bidhaa zako POST /products/qr/:id vendor+ Tengeneza msimbo wa QR wa bidhaa POST /products/image vendor+ Pakia picha ya bidhaa <Callout type="warning" Idhini ya biashara inahitajika — wauzaji wasio na biashara ya APPROVED hupata 403. </Callout Kukuza tangazo (boosts) - POST /products/boost — nunua kukuza tangazo la bidhaa. - GET /products/view-boosts — matangazo yanayotumika. - GET /products/category-analytics — utendaji wa kategoria (mapato = stock × price). Endpoints za mwelekeo (trending) Path Maelezo ------ ------------- GET /products/trending Bidhaa zinazoendelea GET /products/hot-deals Bidhaa zilizopunguzwa bei (≥ 15% punguzo) GET /products/new-arrivals Bidhaa za siku 14 zilizopita GET /products/top-rated Bidhaa zilizopata tathmini za juu <Callout type="note" Orodha hizi za mwelekeo (trending) pia zinajumuishwa kwenye GET /explore na GET /recommendations/ . </Callout

title: Rufaa na mikopo
description: Rejea ya /api/referrals na /api/credits — mpango wa rufaa na mfumo wa zawadi za mikopo.
text: Mpango wa rufaa na mfumo wa mikopo ni kipengele kimoja, kinachodhibitiwa na bendera moja ecommerce:referral credits. Bendera ikizimwa, endpoints za watumiaji hapa chini zinarudisha 503 pamoja na ujumbe uliosanidiwa; endpoints za msimamizi haziathiriwi. <CodeBlock title="Kipengele kimezimwa (503)" json { "message": "Referral system is currently unavailable", "feature": "referral credits", "enabled": false } </CodeBlock Endpoints zote zinahitaji JWT. Endpoints za msimamizi zinahitaji pia jukumu la superAdmin. Zawadi za rufaa Mikopo hutolewa wakati rufaa inapowekwa alama kuwa imekamilika: Nani Mikopo Maelezo ------ -------- ------------- Mwalikaji (referrer) 5,000 Zawadi ya rufaa kwa kumwalika mtumiaji Aliyefikishwa (referred) 2,000 Zawadi ya kukaribishwa baada ya kurejelewa Rufaa iliyokamilika hurekodi rewardAmount: 7000 (5,000 + 2,000). Mikopo iliyopatikana huisha muda wake baada ya miezi 6 . Rufaa (/api/referrals) Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /referrals/my JWT Watumiaji waliofikishwa na mtumiaji wa sasa GET /referrals/stats JWT Takwimu za rufaa GET /referrals/code JWT Msimbo wako wa rufaa (hutengeneza na kuhifadhi mmoja usipokuwepo) POST /referrals/apply JWT Omba msimbo wa rufaa wa mtu mwingine GET /referrals/admin/all superAdmin Rufaa zote (kwa kurasa) GET /referrals/my <CodeBlock title="Jibu (Response)" json { "referrals": [ { "id": "...", "status": "pending", "expiresAt": "2026-11-07T00:00:00.000Z", "rewardAmount": null, "createdAt": "2026-08-07T00:00:00.000Z", "referred": { "id": "...", "fullName": "Jane Doe", "email": "jane@example.com", "createdAt": "2026-08-07T00:00:00.000Z" } } ] } </CodeBlock GET /referrals/stats <CodeBlock title="Jibu (Response)" json { "stats": { "totalReferrals": 3, "completedReferrals": 1, "pendingReferrals": 2, "totalCreditsEarned": 7000 } } </CodeBlock GET /referrals/code Inarudisha msimbo wa rufaa wa mtumiaji wa sasa, na hutengeneza na kuhifadhi mmoja usipokuwepo. Misimbo huanza na kiambishi SP- kikifuatwa na herufi 8 (A–Z, 0–9). <CodeBlock title="Jibu (Response)" json { "referralCode": "SP-AB12CD34" } </CodeBlock POST /referrals/apply <CodeBlock title="Ombi (Request)" json { "referralCode": "SP-AB12CD34" } </CodeBlock Status Hali -------- ------ 200 Msimbo umetumika — { "message": "Referral code applied successfully" } 400 Msimbo haukupatikana, umeshatumika, au unatumia msimbo wako mwenyewe 404 Msimbo si sahihi / hautambuliki Msimbo wa rufaa unaweza kutumika mara moja tu, na kamwe usitumie msimbo wako mwenyewe. Rekodi ya rufaa huanza ikiwa pending. GET /referrals/admin/all Vigezo vya hoja (query): page, limit (msingi 1, 20) na kichujio cha hiari status. <CodeBlock title="Jibu (Response)" json { "referrals": [ ... ], "pagination": { "page": 1, "limit": 20, "total": 42, "pages": 3 } } </CodeBlock Mikopo (/api/credits) Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /credits/my JWT Salio la sasa la mikopo GET /credits/history JWT Historia ya miamala ya mikopo POST /credits/redeem JWT Tumia mikopo kwa kipengele cha mfumo GET /credits/admin/user/:userId superAdmin Mikopo na miamala ya mtumiaji POST /credits/admin/adjust superAdmin Rekebisha mikopo ya mtumiaji kwa mikono GET /credits/my <CodeBlock title="Jibu (Response)" json { "credits": { "id": "...", "userId": "...", "balance": 5000, "totalEarned": 5000, "totalRedeemed": 0, "totalExpired": 0 } } </CodeBlock GET /credits/history <CodeBlock title="Jibu (Response)" json { "history": [ { "id": "...", "type": "earned", "amount": 5000, "description": "Referral reward for referring user", "referenceType": "referral", "referenceId": "...", "expiresAt": "2027-02-07T00:00:00.000Z", "createdAt": "2026-08-07T00:00:00.000Z" } ] } </CodeBlock Thamani za type: earned (zilipatikana), redeemed (zilitumiwa), adjusted (za msimamizi), expired (ziliisha muda wake). POST /credits/redeem Mwili { "feature": "...", "amount": ... } — amount ni hiari na hupata thamani ya gharama ya kipengele kwa msingi. Feature Gharama (mikopo) --------- ---------------- product boost 500 service pin 500 featured listing 1,500 pro trial 2,000 pro month 5,000 business month 10,000 <CodeBlock title="Ombi (Request)" json { "feature": "product boost" } </CodeBlock <CodeBlock title="Jibu (Response)" json { "message": "Credits redeemed successfully", "credit": { "id": "...", "userId": "...", "balance": 4500, "totalEarned": 5000, "totalRedeemed": 500, "totalExpired": 0 } } </CodeBlock Kipengele kisichotambulika kinarudisha 400 pamoja na orodha ya validFeatures; salio lisilotosha linarudisha 400 na ujumbe Insufficient credits. <Callout type="note" Mikopo hutumika kwa kuilipia kipengele cha mfumo kupitia POST /credits/redeem — haitolewi kiotomatiki kwenye malipo ya agizo (checkout). </Callout GET /credits/admin/user/:userId <CodeBlock title="Jibu (Response)" json { "user": { "id": "...", "fullName": "Jane Doe", "email": "jane@example.com" }, "credits": { "id": "...", "userId": "...", "balance": 5000, "totalEarned": 5000, "totalRedeemed": 0, "totalExpired": 0 }, "transactions": [ ... ] } </CodeBlock POST /credits/admin/adjust <CodeBlock title="Ombi (Request)" json { "userId": "...", "amount": 1000, "description": "Promotional bonus" } </CodeBlock amount lazima iwe nambari isiyo sifuri. Thamani chanya huongeza totalEarned; thamani hasi huongeza totalRedeemed na hukataliwa kwa 400 zikizidi salio la sasa. <CodeBlock title="Jibu (Response)" json { "message": "Credits adjusted successfully", "credit": { ... } } </CodeBlock

title: Utafutaji, ugunduzi na mapendekezo
description: Rejea ya /api/search, /api/explore, /api/showcase na /api/recommendations — utafutaji, mapendekezo na mipasho iliyochaguliwa.
text: Utafutaji na ugunduzi hutumika kuendesha ukurasa wa nyumbani na ukurasa wa utafutaji. <Callout type="note" /api/explore na /api/recommendations zinahitaji swichi ya vipengele featured products. Ikizimwa kwenye /admin/ecommerce, endpoints hizo hurudisha 503. </Callout GET /search Global search across products, services, businesses and deliverables. Supports full-text matching, filters (category, price range, region, rating), sorting and pagination. Returns { results, suggestions, trending }. GET /search/trending Maswali ambayo yanaongezeka kasi sasa hivi — yanatumiwa na kisanduku cha utafutaji kwenye ukurasa wa nyumbani. GET /search/suggestions?q=… Mapendekezo ya kukamilisha (autocomplete) kulingana na maandishi uliyochapa. q ni lazima. GET /explore Kila kitu kwenye ukurasa wa "Explore": mipasho, bidhaa zinazopendwa, vibao vya faragha, bidhaa zinazopendwa hivi karibuni na categories kuu. Kwa media uploads (selfie / hati za KYC) na usimamizi wa miradi ya showcase, ona Pakia media & showcase. GET /api/recommendations/… Path Maelezo ------ --------- /trending-up Bidhaa zilizopanda kasi (velocity) katika saa 72 zilizopita dhidi ya rekodi yake ya kawaida; threshold 1.5 /new-arrivals Bidhaa zilizoundwa ndani ya siku 14, zilizopangwa kwa stock /hot-deals Bidhaa zilizo na punguzo ≥ 15%, zilizopangwa kwa mchanganyiko wa maagizo × ubadilishaji × punguzo <Callout type="note" /recommendations/ zote ziko nyuma ya featured products flag na zinarudisha bidhaa kutoka kwa biashara zenye hali APPROVED pekee. </Callout Parameters & usaidizi Param Maelezo ------- --------- q Maswali ya utafutaji (inahitajika kwa /search na /search/suggestions) page / limit Ukumbaji sort newest \ price asc \ price desc \ rating \ popularity filters Hifadhi ya category, priceRange, region, rating, isVerified ESL na ukumbaji Majibu yote ya utafutaji na ugunduzi yanatumia ukumbaji sawia. Angalia viwango vya vivuli vya API kwa maelezo ya page, limit, total na mifuniko.

title: Huduma
description: Rejea ya /api/services — orodha za huduma, CRUD na uidhinishaji.
text: Huduma ni matoleo ya kitaalamu yanayotolewa na watoa huduma. GET /services/all Orodha ya huduma za umma. Kichujio cha category ni hiari. GET /services/:id Maelezo ya huduma moja. Muundo wa huduma (sehemu muhimu) json { "id": "...", "title": "Plumbing repair", "description": "...", "basePrice": 30000, "bannerImage": "https://.../banner.jpg", "adTier": "basic", "status": "approved", "providerId": "...", "categoryId": "..." } Endpoints za mtoa huduma Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- POST /services/add service provider Unda huduma GET /services/my service provider Huduma zako PUT /services/:id service provider Sasisha huduma DELETE /services/:id service provider+ Futa huduma kwa upole GET /services/:id/related Public Hadi huduma 6 zinazohusiana Idhini ya msimamizi Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- PUT /services/:id/approve partnerAdmin+ Idhinisha huduma PUT /services/:id/reject partnerAdmin+ Kataa huduma Kukuza tangazo na kuhifadhi nafasi - POST /services/boosts — nunua kukuza tangazo la huduma. - GET /services/boosts — orodhesha matangazo yaliyokuzwa. - GET /services/popular / in-demand — orodha za umaarufu. - Kuhifadhi nafasi kiko chini ya /api/bookings. <Callout type="note" Watoa huduma pia wanaweza kuuza bidhaa halisi kwa kutumia endpoints za bidhaa, wakifuata sharti lile lile la idhini ya biashara. </Callout

title: Pakia media & showcase
description: Rejea ya /api/upload na /api/showcase — selfie, hati (KYC) na miradi ya showcase.
text: Uploads hudhibitiwa na multer (in-memory, kikomo cha faili 5 MB ) na kupelekwa kwenye Cloudinary. Endpoint zote zinahitaji JWT . Upload / KYC (/api/upload) Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- POST /upload/selfie JWT Pakia picha ya selfie — multipart, field file POST /upload/document JWT Pakia hati (KYC) — multipart, field file Zote hupokea faili moja kwa wakati mmoja, image/ au application/pdf, hadi 5 MB . Zaidi ya faili moja au faili kubwa 400. <Callout type="note" Kwa uthibitisho wa KYC (selfie, hati, hati ya biashara) kila faili huingizwa moja kwa moja. Pakia selfie kwanza, kisha hati. </Callout Majibu yanarudisha URL ya Cloudinary na ujumbe: json { "url": "https://res.cloudinary.com/…/selfie.jpg", "message": "Selfie uploaded" } Showcase (/api/showcase) Miradi ya showcase ni kazi za kuonyesha zinazopatikana kwenye ukurasa wa "showcase" / "explore". Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /showcase — Orodhesha miradi ya showcase POST /showcase/create superAdmin Unda mradi (multipart, field image) PUT /showcase/:id superAdmin Sasisha mradi DELETE /showcase/:id superAdmin Futa mradi

title: Usajili
description: Rejea ya /api/subscriptions — viwango vya mipango, bei, kupandisha, kushusha na mipaka ya kuorodhesha ya muuzaji.
text: Akaunti za wauzaji na watoa huduma zina usajili wenye kiwango (tier) kinachoweka mipaka ya kuorodhesha na haki za kutumia vipengele. Viwango vya mipango na bei Viwango ni free, pro, business na enterprise. Bei ziko kwa TZS kwa mwezi na hutofautiana kwa aina ya akaunti. Kiwango Muuzaji / mwezi Mtoa huduma / mwezi Upeo wa bidhaa Upeo wa huduma ------ ---------------- -------------------------- -------------- -------------- free 0 0 10 3 pro 25,000 20,000 50 15 business 75,000 60,000 200 50 enterprise 150,000 120,000 Bila kikomo Bila kikomo Usajili huhifadhi tier, price, startDate, endDate, isActive, isTrial, paymentMethod, autoRenew na autoDowngrade. Akaunti isiyokuwa na usajili unaoendelea hutumika kama free. Endpoints Method Path Uthibitishaji Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /subscriptions/my JWT Usajili wa sasa, mipaka na bei POST /subscriptions/subscribe vendor/service provider Anza kiwango cha kulipia POST /subscriptions/cancel vendor/service provider Ghairi usajili wa sasa POST /subscriptions/upgrade vendor/service provider Pandisha hadi kiwango cha juu POST /subscriptions/downgrade vendor/service provider Ratibu kushusha hadi kiwango cha chini GET /subscriptions/vendor/:vendorId/limits JWT Mipaka ya kuorodhesha ya muuzaji GET /subscriptions/all superAdmin Orodhesha usajili wote GET /subscriptions/my Inarudisha usajili wa sasa (au muundo wa free ulio wa chaguo-msingi), mipaka ya kiwango, idadi ya sasa ya bidhaa/huduma za mtumiaji na orodha ya bei inayotumika. <CodeBlock title="Jibu" json { "subscription": { "id": "...", "userId": "...", "type": "vendor", "tier": "pro", "price": 25000, "startDate": "2026-07-01T00:00:00.000Z", "endDate": "2026-08-01T00:00:00.000Z", "isActive": true, "isTrial": false, "paymentMethod": "manual" }, "limits": { "products": 50, "services": 15 }, "currentCount": 12, "prices": { "free": 0, "pro": 25000, "business": 75000, "enterprise": 150000 } } </CodeBlock POST /subscriptions/subscribe Huanzisha usajili wa kulipia kwa akaunti iliyothibitishwa. Body: json { "tier": "pro", "paymentMethod": "clickpesa" } tier inahitajika na lazima iwe mojawapo ya free, pro, business, enterprise; paymentMethod ni manual kwa chaguo-msingi ikiachwa wazi. Inarudisha 201 pamoja na usajili ulioundwa. Kusajili kiwango tayari unachonacho kinarudisha 400. <Callout type="warning" subscribe na upgrade zinalindwa na paymentEnabled('subscription'). Wakati huduma ya malipo (ClickPesa) imezimwa au malipo ya usajili yamesimamishwa, endpoints hizi hurudisha 503 na hakuna usajili unaoundwa. </Callout POST /subscriptions/upgrade Pandisha hadi kiwango chenye bei ya juu. Body sawa na subscribe (tier, na paymentMethod ya hiari). Inarudisha 400 pamoja na Use downgradeTier for tier downgrades wakati kiwango lengwa si cha gharama zaidi kabisa. Usajili wa awali huzimwa na mwingine unaundwa kwa bei kamili ya kiwango kipya. POST /subscriptions/downgrade Ratibu kuhamia kiwango cha bei ya chini. Body sawa na subscribe. Inarudisha 400 pamoja na Use upgradeTier for tier upgrades wakati kiwango lengwa si cha bei ya chini kabisa. Usajili ulioshushwa unaundwa ukiwa na isActive: false na autoDowngrade: true na unaanza kutumika kwenye endDate ya usajili wa sasa. <CodeBlock title="Jibu" json { "message": "Downgrade to free scheduled for 2026-08-01T00:00:00.000Z", "subscription": { "tier": "free", "price": 0, "isActive": false, "autoDowngrade": true, "startDate": "2026-08-01T00:00:00.000Z" } } </CodeBlock POST /subscriptions/cancel Inazima mara moja usajili unaoendelea. Inarudisha 404 wakati hakuna usajili unaoendelea. GET /subscriptions/vendor/:vendorId/limits Inarudisha mipaka ya usajili ya wasifu wa biashara ya muuzaji (vendorId ni id ya wasifu wa biashara). Inajumuisha kiwango, mipaka ya products/services, idadi ya sasa ya bidhaa na canAddMore. <CodeBlock title="Jibu" json { "tier": "business", "limits": { "products": 200, "services": 50 }, "currentCount": 47, "canAddMore": true } </CodeBlock Inarudisha 404 wakati muuzaji hajapatikana. GET /subscriptions/all superAdmin pekee. Inaorodhesha kila usajili, kutoka mpya hadi zamani, pamoja na id, fullName na email za mmiliki. Chuja kwa vigezo vya query type (vendor service provider), tier na isActive (true false). <CodeBlock title="Jibu" json { "subscriptions": [ { "id": "...", "type": "vendor", "tier": "pro", "price": 25000, "isActive": true, "user": { "id": "...", "fullName": "Jane Doe", "email": "jane@example.com" } } ], "total": 1 } </CodeBlock

title: Vyuo vikuu (universities)
description: Rejea ya /api/universities — orodhesha vyuo vikuu na usimamizi wa rekodi za vyuo (CRUD ya admin).
text: Vyuo vikuu vinahusishwa na mkoa na vinatumiwa na wasifu za watumiaji, uratibu wa usafirishaji na ununuzi wa sare, vifaa na huduma za wanafunzi. Orodhesha vyuo vikuu Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /universities — Orodhesha vyuo vikuu vikiwemo vya mkoa; chuja kwa ?regionId= Majibu yanarudisha { id, name, code, city, regionId, region: { id, name } } yakiwa yamepangwa kwa name. ?regionId= huchuja kwenye mkoa mmoja. Vyuo vilivyofutwa kwa njia ya soft-delete havionekani. Mfano wa ombi GET /api/universities?regionId=reg arta CRUD ya admin Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- POST /universities majorAdmin, superAdmin Unda chuo kikuu PUT /universities/:id majorAdmin, superAdmin Sasisha chuo kikuu DELETE /universities/:id majorAdmin, superAdmin Futa chuo kikuu kwa njia ya soft-delete Zote tatu zimefungwa kwenye mkoa (region-scoped). majorAdmin anayetenda kwenye chuo kilicho nje ya mkoa wake waliopangiwa anapata 403. <Callout type="note" code hutengenezwa kiotomatiki kutoka jina la chuo likiachiwa wazi na huhifadhiwa kwa herufi za herufi kubwa (uppercase). majorAdmin anaweza kusimamia vyuo vya mkoa wake pekee; superAdmin husimamia vyote. </Callout

title: Watumiaji
description: Rejea ya /api/user na /api/business — wasifu, anwani na usimamizi wa biashara.
text: Endpoints za watumiaji na biashara zinasimamia wasifu na rekodi za biashara za muuzaji/mtoa huduma. Endpoints zote za watumiaji hapa chini zinahitaji JWT. GET /user/profile Wasifu wa mtumiaji wa sasa. Uthibitishaji unahitajika. Inarudisha kitu cha mtumiaji kama JSON bapa (hakijafungwa katika {status, data}) ikijumuisha businessProfile na anwani ya msingi. <CodeBlock title="Jibu (Response)" json { "id": "...", "fullName": "Jane Doe", "email": "you@example.com", "role": "vendor", "phoneNumber": "+255700000000", "avatarUrl": "...", "businessProfile": { "businessName": "Jane's Shop", "status": "APPROVED" }, "addresses": [ { "id": "...", "label": "Home", "streetAddress": "...", "city": "...", "isDefault": true } ] } </CodeBlock GET /auth/me Maelezo kamili ya "wewe ni nani". Uthibitishaji unahitajika. Huu ndio endpoint tajiri zaidi kuhusu mtumiaji wa sasa: unatatua businessProfile (ikijumuisha university na region yake), university, region, majorAdminRegion na adminPermissions za mtumiaji mwenyewe, na kuongeza selfieVerification na firstName. <CodeBlock title="Muundo wa jibu" json { "id": "...", "fullName": "Jane Doe", "role": "vendor", "businessProfile": { "businessName": "Jane's Shop", "university": { "id": "...", "name": "..." }, "region": { "id": "...", "name": "..." } }, "university": { "id": "...", "name": "..." }, "region": { "id": "...", "name": "..." }, "majorAdminRegion": { "region": { "id": "...", "name": "..." } }, "adminPermissions": [{ "permissionKey": "manage orders", "enabled": true }], "selfieVerification": { "status": "..." }, "firstName": "Jane" } </CodeBlock PUT /user/update Sasisha sehemu za jina, simu na anwani. Pia inasawazisha anwani ya msingi: inaisasisha ikiwa tayari ipo, au inaunda moja yenye lebo Home wakati streetAddress na city zote zimetolewa. <CodeBlock title="Ombi (Request)" json { "fullName": "Jane Doe", "phoneNumber": "+255700000000", "streetAddress": "123 Sam Nujoma Road", "district": "Kinondoni", "ward": "Mikocheni", "city": "Dar es Salaam" } </CodeBlock PUT /user/avatar Pakia picha mpya ya avatar (multipart, jina la sehemu avatar). Inarudisha avatarUrl iliyosasishwa. PUT /user/password <CodeBlock title="Ombi (Request)" json { "currentPassword": "old", "newPassword": "new" } </CodeBlock Inarudisha 401 na ujumbe Invalid current password ikiwa nenosiri la sasa si sahihi. Anwani (/api/user/addresses) Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /user/addresses JWT Orodhesha anwani zako (zilizofutwa kwa upole hazijumuishwi) POST /user/addresses JWT Unda anwani (tazama ombi hapa chini) DELETE /user/addresses/:id JWT Futa anwani kwa upole <CodeBlock title="POST /user/addresses" json { "label": "Home", "streetAddress": "123 Sam Nujoma Road", "city": "Dar es Salaam", "district": "Kinondoni", "ward": "Mikocheni", "isDefault": true } </CodeBlock Kuweka isDefault: true kunafuta isDefault kwenye anwani nyingine za mtumiaji. Njia za malipo (/api/user/payments) Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /user/payments JWT Orodhesha njia za malipo zilizohifadhiwa POST /user/payments JWT Hifadhi njia ya malipo <CodeBlock title="POST /user/payments" json { "type": "mobile money", "provider": "M-Pesa", "accountNumber": "+255700000000", "isDefault": true } </CodeBlock DELETE /user/account Inafuta akaunti yako kwa upole: inaweka deletedAt huku ikihifadhi data katika rekodi. Uthibitishaji unahitajika. Mabadiliko ya jukumu na kumbukumbu za shughuli - PUT /users/change-role na GET /users/activity-logs hazipo . Mabadiliko ya jukumu hufanywa na wasimamizi pekee kupitia PUT /admin/users/:userId/role (yanayolindwa na partnerAdmin/majorAdmin/superAdmin na kuwekewa mipaka ya mkoa). Kumbukumbu za shughuli ni za wasimamizi pekee kupitia GET /admin/activity. - Taarifa za rufaa zinapatikana kwenye API ya rufaa: GET /referrals/my, GET /referrals/code na POST /referrals/apply. Endpoints za biashara (/api/business) Method Path Auth Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /business/all Public Biashara zilizoidhinishwa pamoja na idadi GET /business/:id Public Maelezo ya biashara + bidhaa + huduma PUT /business/update vendor+ Unda au sasisha wasifu wa biashara PUT /business/logo vendor+ Pakia nembo (logo) PUT /business/cover vendor+ Pakia picha ya jalada (cover) GET /business/verification-status vendor+ Hali ya idhini ya moja kwa moja POST /business/verify vendor+ Wasilisha ombi la uthibitishaji wa biashara GET /business/balance vendor+ Salio la sasa la mchuuzi (baada ya komisheni) POST /business/payout-request vendor+ Omba malipo ya kutolewa (inahitaji swichi ya payouts) GET /business/payout-history vendor+ Orodhesha ombi za awali za malipo <Callout type="note" Hali ya biashara lazima iwe APPROVED kabla ya mmiliki kuweza kuorodhesha bidhaa au huduma. </Callout

title: Muhtasari wa usanifu wa mfumo
description: Jinsi frontend, backend, hifadhidata na huduma za SokoPlus zinavyoungana.
text: SokoPlus ni programu ya full-stack iliyogawanywa kati ya frontend ya SPA na backend API. Mchoro wa mfumo text ┌──────────────┐ HTTPS ┌──────────────────┐ │ Frontend │ ──────────────▶ │ Backend API │ │ React 19 │ JSON / JWT │ Express 5 │ │ TanStack SSR │ ◀────────────── │ (REST /api/ ) │ └──────────────┘ JSON └────────┬─────────┘ │ ┌───────────┼───────────┐ ▼ ▼ ▼ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ │PostgreSQL│ │ Redis │ │ClickPesa │ │ (Prisma) │ │ (cache) │ │ (payments)│ └──────────┘ └──────────┘ └──────────┘ Muundo wa backend src/ ├── app.js Entry: middleware pipeline, route mounting ├── controllers/ 40 route handler modules ├── routes/ 35 route definition files ├── middleware/ auth, validation, feature guards, rate limiting, errors ├── lib/ db, clickpesa, email, cloudinary, logger, socket, etc. └── services/ escrow, commission, credit, referral, subscription, push Maamuzi muhimu ya kubuni - Express 5 + JavaScript rahisi — marudio ya haraka, ESM kila mahali. - Prisma 7 + adapter ya PrismaPg — ORM iliyo na aina (typed) juu ya PostgreSQL, singleton salama ya hot-reload. - Zod schemas (pakiti ya pamoja) — uthibitisho wa maombi kwenye mutations. - JWT + RBAC middleware — protect + authorize(...roles) kwenye kila njia iliyolindwa. - HMAC webhooks — callbacks za ClickPesa huthibitishwa kwa checksum, hivyo matukio ya malipo yanaaminika. - Swichi za vipengele (feature flags) — jedwali la PlatformSetting (ecommerce:<key ) linaweza kuzima vipengele jukwaani kote. Mkataba wa frontend ↔ backend Frontend inawasiliana na backend kupitia REST API pekee. Hakuna ufikiaji wa moja kwa moja wa hifadhidata kutoka kwa mteja. Mawasiliano yote ni JSON kupitia HTTPS. Mfano wa mtiririko wa data — kuweka agizo 1. Frontend inaongeza bidhaa kwenye rukoba ya ununuzi (POST /cart/add). 2. Malipo ya agizo (POST /orders/checkout) yanathibitisha stock, usafirishaji na saa za kazi. 3. Malipo yanaanzishwa kupitia ClickPesa (POST /payments/initiate). 4. Webhook ya ClickPesa inathibitisha malipo na kusasisha muamala. 5. Agizo linaingia kwenye hali ya inasubiri (pending) na muuzaji anaarifiwa. Wakati halisi (real-time) - socket.io hutuma matukio ya wakati halisi (k.m. uthibitisho wa malipo) kwa wateja walioounganishwa. - Web push / Expo push hupeleka arifa kwa vivinjari na vifaa. - Frontend pia huchunguza (polls) rasilimali muhimu kama njia mbadala.

title: Uthibitishaji
description: Jinsi JWT, OTP na kuingia kwa Google zinavyofanya kazi kwenye API ya SokoPlus, na jinsi ya kulinda vipindi (sessions).
text: SokoPlus hutumia tokeni za JWT bearer kwa maombi yote yaliyothibitishwa. Tokeni hutolewa baada ya kuingia, uthibitishaji wa OTP, au kuingia kwa Google. Kupata tokeni Kuingia kwa barua pepe + nenosiri bash curl -X POST https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api/auth/login \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"email": "you@example.com", "password": "secret"}' <CodeBlock title="Response" json { "status": "success", "data": { "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...", "user": { "id": "...", "email": "you@example.com", "role": "client" } } } </CodeBlock OTP (usajili na urejeshaji) 1. POST /auth/signup ukitumia taarifa zako → hutuma msimbo wa tarakimu 6. 2. POST /auth/otp/verify ukitumia msimbo → hurudisha JWT kwa watumiaji wapya. 3. Kuweka upya nenosiri kunatumia mzunguko huo huo: /auth/forgot-password/send → /verify → /reset. Kuingia kwa Google POST /auth/google ukitumia tokeni ya Google OAuth kutoka kwenye web client ID yako. Kutumia tokeni Tuma kwenye kila ombi lililothibitishwa: bash curl https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api/user/profile \ -H "Authorization: Bearer <token " Endpoints za uthibitishaji Method Path Maelezo -------- ------ ------------- POST /auth/signup Anza usajili (hutuma OTP) POST /auth/login Kuingia kwa barua pepe + nenosiri POST /auth/otp/send Tuma OTP ya uthibitishaji POST /auth/otp/verify Thibitisha OTP (hurudisha JWT ikiwa mtumiaji ni mpya) POST /auth/otp/link Unganisha namba ya simu kwenye akaunti POST /auth/google Kuingia kwa Google OAuth POST /auth/logout Batilisha kipindi (session) POST /auth/refresh Fanya upya tokeni POST /auth/forgot-password/send Tuma OTP ya kuweka upya POST /auth/forgot-password/verify Thibitisha msimbo wa kuweka upya POST /auth/forgot-password/reset Weka nenosiri jipya GET /auth/me Wasifu wa mtumiaji wa sasa (pamoja na biashara) POST /auth/check-exists Angalia ikiwa mtumiaji yupo Uthibitishaji wa tokeni Middleware ya protect: - Inasimbua JWT kutoka kwenye header ya Authorization. - Inapakia mtumiaji kutoka kwenye hifadhidata. - Inawakataa watumiaji waliofutwa kwa upole, waliosimamishwa au wasiostahili. - Inaambatisha mtumiaji kwenye req.user. <Callout type="warning" Majibu ya 401 yanamaanisha tokeni yako haipo, imekwisha muda wake, au mtumiaji amezuiwa. Jithibitishe tena ili kuendelea. </Callout Udhibiti wa ufikiaji kulingana na jukumu (RBAC) hutumika juu ya uthibitishaji wa JWT kwenye API nzima.

title: Ujumuishaji wa ClickPesa
description: Jinsi SokoPlus inavyojumuisha ClickPesa kwa malipo na utoaji wa malipo, ikijumuisha checksum ya HMAC.
text: SokoPlus inatumia ClickPesa kama lango lake la malipo (https://api.clickpesa.com/third-parties). Siri za lango Kigezo cha mazingira Madhumuni ---------------------- --------- CLICKPESA CLIENT ID Client ID ya lango CLICKPESA API KEY API key CLICKPESA CHECKSUM KEY Ufunguo wa kusaini HMAC CLICKPESA WEBHOOK SECRET Uthibitishaji wa webhook CLICKPESA MODE sandbox au production Kuunda payment intent Backend inatengeneza mwili wa ombi uliosainiwa na kuiita API ya ClickPesa kuanzisha malipo ya agizo, usajili wa mwezi au kukuza tangazo. Mwili wa JSON wa canonical hutiwa saini kwa HMAC-SHA256 kwa kutumia ufunguo wa checksum. Uthibitishaji Webhooks na majibu yanayoingia huthibitishwa kwa kukokotoa upya HMAC juu ya mwili wa ombi la canonical na kulinganisha checksums. Ni callbacks zilizothibitishwa pekee zinazoaminika. Utoaji wa malipo (kwa muuzaji) Utoaji wa malipo unafuata muundo huo huo: intent huundwa ukiwa na maelezo ya utoaji wa malipo ya muuzaji, na matokeo huthibitishwa kupitia webhook ya utoaji wa malipo. <Callout type="warning" Weka siri za CLICKPESA mbali na msimbo wa mteja na usiweke kwenye repositori za umma. Zinatakiwa kuwa kwenye vigezo vya mazingira vya seva pekee. </Callout Maelezo ya lango la sasa Kwa sasa jukwaa linaandika muamala na gateway: 'other' ndani huku likielekeza malipo kupitia ClickPesa. Ukisoma thamani za PaymentGateway, tarajia 'other' siku hizi. Endelea - Angalia Webhooks kwa mkataba wa callbacks. - Rejea kamili ya vigezo vya mazingira inapatikana kwa wasimamizi wa jukwaa pekee.

title: Muundo wa data
description: Modeli kuu za Prisma zinazounda SokoPlus — watumiaji, biashara, fedha na uendeshaji.
text: SokoPlus huhifadhi kila kitu kwenye PostgreSQL na kuimodelisha kwa Prisma . Ukurasa huu unaelezea modeli kuu. Utambulisho na majukumu Model Madhumuni ------- --------- User Akaunti yenye enum ya Role, vigezo vya uthibitishaji, kufuta kwa upole BusinessProfile Rekodi ya biashara ya muuzaji/mtoa huduma, 1:1 na mtumiaji, ina hali DeliveryPerson Wanachama wa timu ya usafirishaji wanaounganishwa na biashara + mtumiaji Region / University Mikoa ya Tanzania na muktadha wa kampasi Biashara Model Madhumuni ------- --------- Product Vitu halisi vyenye bei, stock, vipimo na kufuta kwa upole. Picha huishi kwenye bidhaa yenyewe kama safu ya imageUrl (hakuna modeli tofauti ya picha) ProductVariant / WholesaleTier / ProductSpecification Lahaja za bidhaa (type, name, price, stock, SKU), viwango vya bei ya jumla na sifa za key/value Service Huduma za kitaalamu zenye bei ya msingi Category Mti mmoja wa kategoria ulioshirikiwa kwa bidhaa na huduma (ngazi kwa parentId, aina kwa type) Order / OrderItem / OrderSuborder Maagizo yaliyogawanywa kwa biashara yenye data ya usafirishaji, misimbo ya mpokeaji na QR kwa kila suborder CartItem Vipengee vya rukoba (bidhaa + lahaja ya hiari). Rukoba yenyewe huhifadhiwa upande wa mteja (frontend) Booking Kuhifadhi nafasi za huduma na kukubali/kukataa + msimbo wa kuhifadhi nafasi Fedha Model Madhumuni ------- --------- Transaction Rekodi za malipo (hali, gateway) PaymentMethod Njia za malipo zilizohifadhiwa kwa kila mtumiaji Payout Utoaji wa malipo kwa wauzaji Escrow Fedha zilizohifadhiwa kati ya malipo na uthibitisho Commission Komisheni ya jukwaa kwa kila agizo Refund Ombi la kurudishiwa fedha linalounganishwa na agizo Credit / CreditTransaction Salio za referral/mikopo ya salio VendorBalance / VendorBalanceLog Salio la mapato ya muuzaji + leja (ledger) Subscription Mipango ya viwango vya wauzaji ServiceBoost / ProductBoost Orodha zilizokuzwa (matangazo) Coupon Misimbo ya punguzo FlashSale (+ FlashSaleParticipant) Matoleo yenye muda Referral Viungo vya referral na zawadi Mawasiliano Model Madhumuni ------- --------- Message Ujumbe wa moja kwa moja baina ya watumiaji Notification Arifa za mfumo SupportTicket Mijadala ya usaidizi wa wateja CustomerReport Ripoti za bug/lalamiko/kipengele Feedback / Review Maoni yenye tathmini na udhibiti wa maudhui WebPushSubscription Usajili wa push kwenye vivinjari — id, userId, endpoint, p256dh, auth, createdAt; safu moja kwa kila mtumiaji+kivinjari (@@unique([userId, endpoint])), inafutwa kwa cascade pamoja na mtumiaji Uendeshaji Model Madhumuni ------- --------- PlatformSetting Usanidi wa key-value (pamoja na swichi za vipengele vya ecommerce) PlatformContent Kurasa za CMS (faragha, sheria) FAQ Maswali yanayoulizwa mara kwa mara ActivityLog Rekodi ya ukaguzi (audit trail) AdminPermission Vigezo vya ruhusa kwa kila msimamizi OtpCode Nenosiri la wakati mmoja TokenBlacklist Tokeni zilizobatilishwa WorkingHours Ratiba za biashara DeliveryZone Maeneo ya usafirishaji + ada ShowcaseProject Miradi ya nje iliyokuzwa Suborders Order inaweza kuwa na vitu kutoka kwa wauzaji mbalimbali kwenye checkout moja. Wakati wa kuundwa, hugawanywa kuwa OrderSuborder moja kwa kila biashara ; kila suborder ina mzunguko wake wa utekelezaji: Sehemu Madhumuni ------- --------- orderId / businessId Agizo la mzazi na biashara inayomiliki subtotal Jumla ya vitu vya biashara hiyo status Thamani yake ya OrderStatus kwa kila suborder recipientCode Msimbo wa pekee wa uthibitishaji wa usafirishaji wa pande tatu kwa suborder hii negotiatedAmount / collectedAmount Bei iliyojadiliwa na kiasi kilichokusanywa wakati wa kukabidhi hasDelivery / deliveryCost Bendera ya usafirishaji + ada kwa kila suborder deliveryPersonId / deliveryVerified / deliveryVerifiedAt Ugawaji + uthibitisho wa kukabidhiwa deliveryLocation / deliveryLat / deliveryLng Sehemu ya GPS ya kukabidhi cancelledAt / cancelReason Wakati na kwa nini suborder ilighairiwa Agizo moja kwa hiyo linaweza kuonyesha hali nyingi na misimbo mingi ya mpokeaji kwa wakati mmoja. Payload ya QR ya usafirishaji inasimbua suborder: { v:1, o:<suborderId , r:<recipientCode , s:1 } — endpoints za uthibitisho zinakubali suborderId + recipientId ili kulenga suborder sahihi. Sehemu za ngazi ya agizo pia zipo kwa ajili ya mtiririko wa zamani/wa muuzaji mmoja na uhasibu wa agizo lote: Sehemu Madhumuni ------- --------- deliveryVerified / recipientId Uthibitishaji wa zamani wa usafirishaji wa muuzaji mmoja negotiatedAmount / collectedAmount Bei iliyojadiliwa na kiasi kilichokusanywa kwa agizo lote cancelReason Kwa nini agizo liliighairiwa Safu za OrderItem zinanakili bidhaa wakati wa ununuzi (productId, productName, productPrice, quantity, imageUrl) pamoja na lahaja iliyochaguliwa (variantId, variantName, variantType) na selectedSpecs / notes. Kila kipengee kinaunganishwa na suborder inayomiliki kupitia suborderId. Endpoints zinazofanya kazi kwenye sehemu ya biashara moja (/orders/:id/status, /orders/:id/verify-recipient, /delivery/assign, /delivery/:id/verify) zinakubali suborderId ya hiari ili kulenga suborder sahihi. Muundo wa kufuta kwa upole Modeli nyingi zina deletedAt + deletedBy. Kufuta kunajaza sehemu hizo; queries za kawaida hazizijumlishi. Msimamizi anaweza kurejesha au kufuta kabisa kupitia /admin/records. Enums Enum Thamani ------ -------- Role client, vendor, service provider, delivery, partnerAdmin, majorAdmin, superAdmin PaymentStatus unpaid, paid, refunded, partial TransactionStatus pending, success, failed, refunded, held, released PayoutStatus pending, processing, completed, failed PaymentGateway selcom, stripe, tigo pesa, mpesa, airtel money, bank transfer, clickpesa, other EscrowStatus held, released, refunded, expired SubscriptionTier free, pro, business, enterprise SubscriptionType vendor, service provider BoostType pin, featured, spotlight Hali za biashara na maagizo ni sehemu rahisi za aina ya string , si enums za Prisma: BusinessProfile.status inatumia APPROVED, PENDING, REJECTED, SUSPENDED; Order.status na OrderSuborder.status zinatumia pending, confirmed, shipped, delivered, cancelled (returned pia inakubaliwa kupitia njia ya admin). <Callout type="note" Schema halisi ya Prisma iko kwenye repo ya backend chini ya prisma/schema.prisma — chukulia ukurasa huu kama muhtasari. </Callout

title: Swichi za vipengele (udhibiti wa ecommerce)
description: Swichi za vipengele zinazoendeshwa na PlatformSetting ambazo huwezesha au kuzima uwezo wa jukwaa kote kwa ujumla.
text: SokoPlus inaweza kuzima vipengele vyote kwa wakati halisi (runtime) kwa kutumia swichi za vipengele zilizohifadhiwa kwenye PlatformSetting chini ya funguo kama ecommerce:<feature . Zinafanya kazi vipi - Kila swichi ina enabled na message ya hiari. - Middleware ya featureEnabled(key) inarudisha 503 pamoja na { message, feature, enabled: false } kipengele kikiwa kimezimwa. god mode inapita kwenye kila ulinzi; maintenance mode inatumika kwa jukwaa lote lakini haitoi /api/auth, /api/admin na /health. - Swichi hudhibitiwa na superAdmin kupitia GET /admin/ecommerce (orodhesha zote) na GET/PUT /admin/ecommerce/:id (soma/badilisha moja). GET /admin/ecommerce/public inaonyesha orodha ile ile bila auth ya admin (bila message). Orodha ya swichi Ufunguo Hudhibiti Default ----- ---------- --------- ordering Kuweka maagizo imewashwa registration Usajili wa watumiaji wapya imewashwa vendor signup Usajili wa wauzaji imewashwa service provider signup Usajili wa watoa huduma imewashwa product listing Kuorodhesha bidhaa imewashwa service listing Kuorodhesha huduma imewashwa checkout Mchakato wa malipo (checkout) imewashwa wishlist Orodha ya matamanio imewashwa reviews Maoni imewashwa vendor verification Kuhitaji uthibitishaji wa muuzaji imewashwa commission Ufuatiliaji wa komisheni imewashwa refunds Kurudishiwa fedha imewashwa messaging Ujumbe imewashwa notifications Arifa imewashwa maintenance mode Hali ya matengenezo imezimwa featured products Bidhaa zilizoangaziwa imewashwa god mode Uepukaji wa msimamizi mkuu imezimwa payment service Usindikaji wa malipo ya mtandaoni (ClickPesa) imezimwa subscription Usajili wa mwezi wa wauzaji imewashwa boosts Kukuza tangazo la bidhaa/huduma imewashwa flash sales Mauzo ya haraka (flash sales) imewashwa coupons Kuponi imewashwa referral credits Marejeleo na mikopo ya salio imewashwa Jedwali hili linafuata ECOMMERCE CONTROLS kwenye adminController.js. Hakuna udhibiti unaoitwa discounts enabled. Utekelezaji upande wa seva Swichi nyingi pia hutekelezwa kwenye safu ya routes na featureEnabled(...), kwa hiyo kuzima kipengele kunarudisha 503 moja kwa moja kutoka kwa API — si tu kuficha kwenye UI: - subscription — endpoints zote za /api/subscriptions (my, subscribe, cancel, upgrade, downgrade, all). - boosts — kuorodhesha na kununua service boost (GET /api/services/my/boosts, POST /api/services/boost). - coupons — kuunda, kusasisha, kufuta, kuorodhesha, validate na apply (/api/coupons/ ). - flash sales — kujiunga kwa muuzaji (POST /api/flash-sales/join/:flashSaleId). - referral credits — endpoints za referral (/api/referrals/my, /api/referrals/stats, /api/referrals/code, /api/referrals/apply) na endpoints za mikopo (/api/credits/my, /api/credits/history, /api/credits/redeem). Payment service ikiwa imezimwa = Cash on Delivery payment service ni swichi kuu ya malipo ya mtandaoni pekee. Ikiwa imezimwa: - Malipo ya mtandaoni yamezimwa — vipengele vya fedha vinavyohitaji payment gate (subscriptions, boosts, coupon redemption, payouts, credits) vinarudisha 503 pamoja na "Digital payments are currently offline. Cash on delivery only." - Kuweka maagizo na checkout vinaendelea — ordering na checkout ni swichi huru. Checkout inapita kwenye payment-service gate ili maagizo yaendelee kuwekwa. - Checkout inarudisha requiresPayment: false na agizo linawekwa kama Cash on Delivery : mshirika wa usafirishaji anakusanya wakati wa kukabidhi, na escrow bado inaundwa (kwa default) na kutolewa kwa kila suborder inapothibitishwa. Angalia Maagizo, rukoba ya ununuzi na kuhifadhi nafasi kwa umbo la jibu la checkout. Hadhira Hadhira Inaarifiwa wakati wa kuwasha/zima ---------- -------------------- all Watumiaji wote businesses Wauzaji + watoa huduma none Hakuna (kimya) Mfano bash Zima uwekaji wa maagizo kote kwenye jukwaa curl -X PUT https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api/admin/ecommerce/ordering \ -H "Authorization: Bearer <superadmin-token " \ -d '{"enabled": false, "message": "Ordering is temporarily paused."}' <Callout type="warning" Kubadilisha maintenance mode au god mode kunaweza kuzuia shughuli halisi za watumiaji. Kuzima payment service kunasitisha malipo yote ya mtandaoni lakini kuweka maagizo ya COD kunabaki. Tumia kwa uangalifu mkubwa. </Callout

title: Hifadhi ya malipo (escrow) na komisheni
description: Jinsi escrow inavyolinda shughuli za kifedha na jinsi komisheni za jukwaa zinavyofuatiliwa.
text: Taratibu mbili zinahifadhi usawa wa usafirishaji wa fedha: escrow (hifadhi ya malipo) na komisheni . Escrow (/api/escrow) Escrow hushikilia fedha hadi usafirishaji uthibitishwe. Mbinu Njia Uthibitishaji Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /escrow/status/:orderId JWT Hali ya escrow ya agizo POST /escrow/initiate-release admin Toa fedha kwa muuzaji POST /escrow/initiate-refund admin Rudisha fedha kwa mteja POST /escrow/confirm admin Thibitisha utoaji/kurudishiwa POST /escrow/process-expired superAdmin Fagia escrow zilizoisha muda Mzunguko wa maisha wa escrow 1. Imeundwa (Created) — wakati webhook ya malipo ya agizo inapothibitishwa. 2. Imehifadhiwa (Held) — fedha zinakaa hadi agizo litakapowasilishwa na kuthibitishwa. 3. Imetolewa (Released) — fedha zinakwenda kwa muuzaji baada ya uthibitisho wa upokeaji. 4. Imerudishiwa (Refunded) — fedha zinarejea kwa mteja baada ya kurudishiwa fedha kuidhinishwa. Komisheni Jukwaa litoza komisheni kwenye maagizo (inafuatiliwa kwenye mfano wa Commission). Sehemu Maelezo ------- ------------- businessId Muuzaji anayepokea agizo orderId Agizo linalohusika amount Kiasi cha komisheni rate Kiwango cha komisheni status Inasubiri / imelipwa - Komisheni huorodheshwa chini ya GET /admin/commissions (superAdmin). - Tia alama kuwa imelipwa kupitia PUT /admin/commissions/:id/pay. <Callout type="note" Ufuatiliaji wa komisheni unaweza kuwashwa au kuzimwa kupitia swichi ya commission. </Callout Mtiririko kamili wa fedha text Buyer pays ──▶ Escrow held ──▶ Delivery confirmed ──▶ Released to vendor │ └──▶ Commission recorded ──▶ Paid out Inayofuata - Angalia Muhtasari wa malipo. - Angalia Swichi za vipengele kwa udhibiti wa komisheni.

title: Utangulizi
description: Muhtasari wa API ya jukwaa la SokoPlus — ni nini, teknolojia zinazotumika, na imekusudiwa nani.
text: Nyandiko hili linahusu jukwaa la SokoPlus: API yake ya umma , mfano wa data , na dhana za soko hili la kidijitali. Limekusudiwa wasanidi programu wanaojenga juu ya SokoPlus au kuunganisha mifumo yao wenyewe. Jukwaa kwa mtazamo wa haraka - Frontend: React 19 + TanStack Start (SSR), Tailwind CSS v4, lugha mbili EN/SW - Backend: Node.js + Express 5 (ESM) - Hifadhidata: PostgreSQL 17 kupitia Prisma 7 - Uthibitishaji: JWT (bearer) + OTP + Google OAuth, udhibiti wa ufikiaji kulingana na jukumu - Malipo: ClickPesa kwa webhooks zilizothibitishwa kwa HMAC - Realtime: socket.io + arifa za kusukuma (web-push + Expo) API API ya REST imewekwa chini ya /api. Majibu yote ni JSON. Uendeshaji (mutations) kwa kawaida huhitaji uthibitishaji, na middleware ya majukumu hutekeleza nani anayeweza kupiga kila aina ya maombi. <Callout type="note" Katika nyandiko hili zima, base URL inaonyeshwa kama https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api. Mazingira yako halisi yanaweza kutofautiana — angalia usanidi wa usambazaji wako. </Callout Utapata nini hapa Sehemu Yaliyomo --------- ---------- Kuanza haraka Njia ya haraka zaidi ya kuwa na muunganisho unaofanya kazi Uthibitishaji JWT, OTP, kuingia kwa Google, majukumu na ruhusa Rejea ya API Nyandiko kwa kila endpoint, limetungwa kulingana na rasilimali Malipo na webhooks ClickPesa, escrow, komisheni, uthibitishaji wa sahihi wa webhook Dhana za jukwaa Mfano wa data, swichi za vipengele, arifa, vikomo vya viwango Usambazaji Kuendesha backend na vigezo vya mazingira — zimezuiliwa : zinaonekana tu kwa wasimamizi wa jukwaa waliothibitishwa <Callout type="note" Kurasa nne za sehemu ya waendelezaji (api-admin, roles-permissions, deployment, environment-variables) zimezuiliwa na hutolewa kutoka kwenye backend. Unahitaji tokeni ya ufikiaji wa nyaraka au kipindi cha super-admin kuziona. </Callout Kuhusu uthabiti Jukwaa linaendelea kusitawi kikamilifu. Njia za endpoint ni thabiti, lakini sehemu za majibu zinaweza kubadilika. Fuata tarehe za updated kwenye kila ukurasa na ufuatilie changelog.

title: Arifa na push
description: Jinsi arifa za mfumo na ujumbe wa push unavyofanya kazi — Expo push, web push, mapendeleo.
text: Arifa zinawafanya watumiaji kuwa na taarifa. Backend huzitoa kupitia njia tatu: ndani ya programu (in-app) , Expo push (simu), na web push (kivinjari). Njia Njia Utaratibu Lini --------- ----------- ------ In-app Safu za Notification + socket.io emit Daima Expo push expoPushToken kwenye mtumiaji, expo-server-sdk Programu za simu Web push WebPushSubscription + maktaba ya web-push (VAPID) Kivinjari Kujisajili kwa push bash Simu (tokeni ya Expo) curl -X PUT https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api/notifications/update-expo-token \ -H "Authorization: Bearer <token " \ -d '{"expoPushToken": "ExponentPushToken[...]"}' Wavuti (usajili wa push) curl -X POST https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api/notifications/register-token \ -H "Authorization: Bearer <token " \ -d '{"subscription": {"endpoint": "...", "keys": {"auth": "...", "p256dh": "..."}}}' Mapendeleo Watumiaji wanaweza kukandamiza aina za arifa kupitia GET/PUT /api/notifications/preferences. Mapendeleo Hudhibiti ------------ ---------- order updates Hali ya agizo, usafirishaji, escrow promotions Matangazo, kukuza tangazo, kuponi general Mengine yote Kinachochochea arifa - Agizo limewekwa / hali imebadilika - Usafirishaji umekabidhiwa / umethibitishwa - Ujumbe mpya - Uidhinishaji / ukataliwa wa muuzaji - Matukio ya malipo au kurudishiwa fedha - Mabadiliko ya swichi za vipengele (yatangazwa kwa hadhira) Kutuma matangazo (msimamizi) Mbinu Njia Maelezo -------- ------ ------------- POST /api/notifications/notify-all Aarifu kila mtumiaji POST /api/notifications/notify-vendor Aarifu wauzaji wote <Callout type="note" notify-all inaweza kuwa ghali — inatumwa kwa kila tokeni iliyosajiliwa. Itumie kwa uchache. </Callout Vidokezo vya usalama - Usiwahi kuweka kwenye logi expoPushToken au funguo za faragha za VAPID. - Funguo za VAPID zinapaswa kuwa kwenye vigezo vya mazingira (VAPID PUBLIC KEY, VAPID PRIVATE KEY). - Heshimu mapendeleo ya watumiaji kabla ya kutuma push za matangazo.

title: Muhtasari wa malipo
description: Mtiririko wa malipo kwenye SokoPlus — intents, utoaji wa malipo, na jinsi fedha zinavyosafiri.
text: Malipo kwenye SokoPlus hupitia lango la malipo (payment gateway) (ClickPesa). Mtiririko umegawanyika katika kuzindua (unaunda payment intent) na kuthibitisha (webhook ya lango hutuambia kwamba imefanikiwa). Endpoints za malipo (/api/payments) Mbinu Njia Uthibitishaji Maelezo -------- ------ ------ ------------- POST /payments/initiate JWT Tengeneza payment intent (agizo) POST /payments/initiate-payout admin Zindua utoaji wa malipo kwa muuzaji GET /payments/payout-status vendor Angalia hali ya utoaji wa malipo GET /payments/vendor-balance vendor Salio la mapato ya muuzaji POST /payments/purchase-subscription vendor Nunua usajili wa mwezi POST /payments/purchase-boost vendor Nunua kukuza tangazo la huduma POST /payments/purchase-product-boost vendor Nunua kukuza tangazo la bidhaa Mtiririko wa malipo ya agizo 1. Checkout — POST /orders/checkout huunda agizo pamoja na payment intent. 2. Zindua — POST /payments/initiate huunda malipo ya lango kwa agizo. 3. Lango — mteja anakamilisha malipo (mobile money, kadi, n.k.). 4. Webhook — ClickPesa hupiga /api/clickpesa/payment na matokeo. 5. Thibitisha — backend husasisha shughuli na agizo, na kuunda rekodi ya escrow. Utoaji wa malipo (payouts) Mapato ya muuzaji hukusanyika kama salio. Utoaji wa malipo huzinduliwa na msimamizi na kuthibitishwa kupitia webhook ya utoaji wa malipo ya ClickPesa. <Callout type="note" Shughuli zote hurekodi TransactionStatus, PaymentStatus na PaymentGateway ili kumbukumbu ya fedha iweze kufuatiliwa (auditable). </Callout Mfano wa shughuli Sehemu muhimu: Sehemu Maelezo ------- ------------- amount Kiasi kwa TZS status Hali ya shughuli paymentStatus Hali ya malipo gateway Lango lililotumika orderId Agizo linalohusika (linaweza kutokuwa na thamani) type Agizo / usajili wa mwezi / kukuza tangazo Inayofuata - Angalia Muunganisho wa ClickPesa kwa maelezo maalum ya lango. - Angalia Webhooks kwa jinsi viitikio (callbacks) vinavyothibitishwa.

title: Kuanza haraka
description: Njia ya haraka zaidi ya kuwa na muunganisho wa API ya SokoPlus unaofanya kazi — base URL, uthibitishaji, na maombi ya kwanza.
text: Hapa kuna njia ya haraka zaidi ya kufanya ombi lako la kwanza lililothibitishwa. 1. Pata base URL Maombi yote ya API yanatumia: text https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api 2. Ukaguzi wa afya ya seva Thibitisha kuwa API inapatikana: bash curl https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api/health <CodeBlock title="Response" json { "status": "ok", "database": "connected" } </CodeBlock 3. Jisajili au ingia Ili kupata tokeni, jisajili mtumiaji na uthibitishe OTP, au ingia na akaunti iliyopo: bash curl -X POST https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api/auth/login \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"email": "you@example.com", "password": "your-password"}' <CodeBlock title="Response (truncated)" json { "status": "success", "data": { "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs..." } } </CodeBlock 4. Piga endpoint iliyohitaji uthibitishaji Tuma tokeni kama bearer header: bash curl https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api/user/profile \ -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs..." 5. Chunguza endpoints za umma Hakuna tokeni inayohitajika kwa hizi: Endpoint Madhumuni ---------- --------- GET /products/all Orodhesha bidhaa GET /services/all Orodhesha huduma GET /business/all Orodhesha biashara zilizoidhinishwa GET /categories Orodhesha kategoria GET /explore Ugunduzi wa soko Vichwa vya kawaida Kichwa Thamani Lini -------- ------- ------ Authorization Bearer <jwt Maombi yote yaliyothibitishwa Content-Type application/json Miili yote ya JSON <Callout type="warning" Linde siri ya JWT yako upande wa mteja. Usiweke tokeni kwenye hazina za umma (public repositories). </Callout Hatua inayofuata: elewa jinsi uthibitishaji unavyofanya kazi.

title: Kikomo cha maombi na usalama
description: Kikomo cha maombi (rate limit) cha API, uthibitishaji wa data, na vichwa vya usalama vinavyowekwa na backend ya SokoPlus.
text: Backend hutumia safu kadhaa za ulinzi kwa kila ombi. Kikomo cha maombi (rate limit) Vikomo vya maombi hutumika kwa ujumla na kwenye njia nyeti: Kizuia Wigo Kikomo --------- ------- ------- globalLimiter Maombi yote ya /api/ 200 kwa dakika 15 authLimiter Maombi yote ya /api/auth/ 20 kwa dakika 15 userStrictLimiter Maombi yasiyo ya GET 30 kwa dakika <CodeBlock title="429 response" json { "status": "error", "message": "Too many requests, please try again later." } </CodeBlock <Callout type="tip" Heshimu vichwa vya Retry-After na ongeza muda polepole (exponential backoff) badala ya kurudia ombi mara moja. </Callout Uthibitishaji wa data - Schemata za Zod (kutoka kifurushi cha @trustflow/shared) huthibitisha miili ya maombi kwenye uendeshaji. - Minyororo ya awali ya express-validator bado ipo kwenye src/middleware/validate.js. - Data isiyo sahihi inarudisha 400 Bad Request pamoja na makosa ya sehemu husika. Vichwa vya usalama (Helmet) Helmet huweka vichwa ili kuzuia mashambulizi ya kawaida: - X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, X-XSS-Protection - Strict-Transport-Security, mwongozo wa Content-Security-Policy - Referrer-Policy na Permissions-Policy CORS Ni asili zilizoorodheshwa kwenye orodha nyeupe (kutoka CORS ORIGIN / CORS ORIGIN2) tu zinazoweza kupiga API kutoka kwa vivinjari. Kila kitu kingine kinazuiwa. Ulinzi mwingine - Usafishaji wa data (input sanitization) — frontend huondoa HTML kutoka kwa data inayotoka. - Ufutaji laini (soft deletes) — vitendo vinavyoharibu huweka deletedAt badala ya kuondoa safu. - Kumbukumbu za shughuli (activity logging) — vitendo vya msimamizi vinarekodiwa kwa uthibitisho. - Walinda vipengele (feature guards) — vipengele vilivyozimwa hurudisha 503 na ujumbe unaoweza kubadilishwa.

title: Webhooks
description: Jinsi webhooks za malipo na utoaji wa malipo za ClickPesa zinavyofanya kazi, na jinsi backend inavyozithibitisha.
text: Webhooks ni njia ya lango kuiambia backend kwamba malipo au utoaji wa malipo umekamilika. Ni endpoints za HTTP zisizohitaji uthibitishaji ambazo zinalindwa badala yake kwa uthibitishaji wa checksum. Endpoints Endpoint Madhumuni ---------- --------- POST /api/clickpesa/payment Matokeo ya malipo POST /api/clickpesa/payout Matokeo ya utoaji wa malipo Mtiririko wa uthibitishaji 1. ClickPesa hutuma mwili wa JSON pamoja na checksum. 2. Backend huhesabu upya sahihi ya HMAC-SHA256 kwenye mwili wa canonical kwa kutumia CLICKPESA CHECKSUM KEY. 3. Ikiwa checksum zinalingana, tukio linachakatwa. 4. Vinginevyo, webhook hukataliwa. <CodeBlock title="Pseudocode" js const expected = hmacSHA256(canonicalJson(body), CHECKSUM KEY) if (headerChecksum !== expected) return res.status(401).end() </CodeBlock Athari za webhook ya malipo Kwa malipo yaliyothibitishwa: - Transaction inasasishwa (hali, hali ya malipo, marejeleo). - Agizo linalohusika linasasishwa. - Rekodi ya escrow inaundwa kwa agizo. - Usajili wa mwezi / kukuza tangazo la huduma huamilishwa malipo yakifika. - Mtumiaji anaarifiwa kupitia socket.io / push. <Callout type="warning" Idempotency ni muhimu — shughulikia uwasilishaji wa webhook unaorudiwa kwa ustadi (mf. angalia hali ya shughuli kabla ya kuchakata tena). </Callout Kusanidi webhooks zako mwenyewe Muunganisho wako unapaswa: 1. Kufungua URL ambayo ClickPesa inaweza kuifikia. 2. Kuthibitisha checksum kwenye kila callback kabla ya kuiamini. 3. Kujibu haraka (2xx) ili lango lisirudie tena. 4. Kulinganisha na rekodi zako za shughuli. Inayofuata - Angalia Muunganisho wa ClickPesa. - Angalia Hifadhi ya malipo na komisheni kwa kinachotokea baada ya malipo.

title: Uthibitishaji wa akaunti
description: Jinsi uthibitishaji wa barua pepe, simu na biashara unavyofanya kazi kwenye SokoPlus, na kwa nini ni muhimu kwa imani.
text: SokoPlus imejengwa juu ya imani. Uthibitishaji huhakikisha kwamba akaunti ni za watu halisi na biashara halisi. Uthibitishaji wa barua pepe - Nambari ya tarakimu 6 inatumwa kwa barua pepe yako unapojisajili. - Ingiza nambari hiyo kuamsha akaunti yako. - Ikiwa barua pepe yako itabadilika baadaye, utaulizwa kuthibitisha anwani mpya. Uthibitishaji wa simu - Nambari ya tarakimu 6 inatumwa kupitia SMS kwa simu yako. - Kuingiza nambari hiyo huunganisha namba yako ya simu na akaunti yako. - Unaweza pia kuunganisha namba ya simu na akaunti iliyopo baadaye kutoka kwenye mipangilio ya wasifu wako. Uthibitishaji wa biashara (ID) Kwa wauzaji na watoa huduma, msimamizi anakagua maombi yako ya biashara. Ukaguzi unahusu maelezo ya biashara yako na, katika hali zingine, nyaraka za ID. Hali Maana -------- --------- Inasubiri Maombi yako yanasubiri ukaguzi. Imeidhinishwa Biashara yako imewashwa na inaweza kuorodhesha bidhaa au huduma. Imekataliwa Maombi yako yalikataliwa. Kwa kawaida utapokea sababu. Imesimamishwa Biashara yako ilisimamishwa na msimamizi. <Callout type="warning" Huwezi kuorodhesha bidhaa au huduma mpaka hali ya biashara yako iwe Imeidhinishwa . </Callout Kwa nini uthibitishaji ni muhimu - Wanunuzi wanaweza kuamini kwamba wanashughulika na biashara halisi. - Jukwaa linaweza kuwawajibisha wauzaji kupitia maoni na ripoti. - Inapunguza ulaghai, orodha za bidhaa zisizo halisi na usafirishaji usiofika. Umepoteza nenosiri? Tumia kiungo cha Umesahau nenosiri kwenye skrini ya kuingia — utapokea OTP kupitia barua pepe ili ukiweke upya.

title: Kuwa mshirika wa usafirishaji
description: Jinsi washirika wa usafirishaji wanavyoumbwa, jinsi ya kutumia app ya usafirishaji, na jinsi ya kusimamia upatikanaji wako.
text: Washirika wa usafirishaji ni watu wanaofanya usafirishaji kwa wauzaji kwenye SokoPlus. Jinsi unavyokuwa mshirika wa usafirishaji Washirika wa usafirishaji huumbwa na wauzaji . Wakati muuzaji anapoongeza mwanachama kwenye timu yake ya usafirishaji, mfumo huumba akaunti ya usafirishaji kwa mwanachama huyo kiotomatiki ikiwa na vitambulisho vya kuingia. 1. Muuzaji wako anaumba akaunti yako kwa kutumia jina, simu na barua pepe yako. 2. Unapokea maelezo ya kuingia ya kushirikiwa (muuzaji ndiye huyatoa). 3. Ingia kwenye app ya SokoPlus na uanze kukubali usafirishaji. <Callout type="note" Ikiwa wewe ni mtu binafsi unayetaka kufanya usafirishaji, wasiliana na wauzaji ambao ungependa kufanya kazi nao — wanaweza kukuongeza kwenye timu yao ya usafirishaji. </Callout Dashibodi yako ya usafirishaji Kama mshirika wa usafirishaji, unakuwa na dashibodi yenye mambo muhimu tu: - Muhtasari — takwimu na usafirishaji unaosubiri - Vifurushi — usafirishaji wote uliokabidhiwa kwako pamoja na mchakato wa uthibitishaji - Wasifu — taarifa zako, swichi ya upatikanaji, na kubadilisha nenosiri Upatikanaji Badilisha hali yako kuwa kwenye mtandao au nje ya mtandao kutoka kwenye wasifu wako. Ukiwa kwenye mtandao, wauzaji wanaweza kukukabidhi usafirishaji. Arifa Utapata arifa wakati muuzaji anapokukabidhi usafirishaji. Weka arifa zikiwa zimewashwa ili usikose kazi. Uko tayari kufanya usafirishaji? Tazama Kukamilisha usafirishaji & uthibitishaji wa ID.

title: Kuwa mtoa huduma
description: Jinsi ya kujisajili kama mtoa huduma, kuweka wasifu wako na kutoa huduma za kitaalamu kwenye SokoPlus.
text: Watoa huduma hutoa huduma za kitaalamu — ukarabati, kubuni (design), msaada wa kiufundi, upigaji picha, logistics na nyinginezo — kwa wateja kote Tanzania. 1. Jisajili kama mtoa huduma Jisajili kwa jukumu la Mtoa huduma . Kama wauzaji, akaunti yako huanza kama inasubiri mpaka biashara yako iidhinishwe. 2. Kamilisha wasifu wa biashara yako Kutoka kwenye dashibodi yako, fungua kichupo cha Biashara : - Jina la biashara na maelezo - Maelezo ya mawasiliano (barua pepe, WhatsApp, simu) - Anwani na eneo - Namba ya usajili wa biashara / namba ya kodi (si lazima) - Nembo (logo) na picha ya jalada 3. Idhinishwa Msimamizi anakagua maombi yako. Unaweza kuangalia hali ya uthibitishaji wako moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye kichupo cha Biashara. <Callout type="warning" Huwezi kuorodhesha huduma mpaka hali ya biashara yako iwe Imeidhinishwa . </Callout 4. Orodhesha huduma zako Ukishaidhinishwa: - Ongeza huduma kwa kutumia kichwa, maelezo, bei ya msingi, picha ya bango na kategoria. - Weka saa zako za kazi ili wateja wajue wakati unavyopatikana. - Simamia bookings zinapoingia. Orodha ya ukaguzi kwa mtoa huduma - [ ] Akaunti imeidhinishwa - [ ] Wasifu wa biashara umekamilika - [ ] Angalau huduma moja imeorodheshwa - [ ] Saa za kazi zimewekwa Uko tayari kuorodhesha huduma? Tazama Kusimamia huduma.

title: Kuwa muuzaji
description: Jinsi ya kujisajili kama muuzaji, kuweka wasifu wa biashara yako na kuidhinishwa kuuza kwenye SokoPlus.
text: Kuwa muuzaji kwenye SokoPlus hukuruhusu kuuza bidhaa halisi kwa wanunuzi kote Tanzania. 1. Jisajili kama muuzaji Jisajili kwa jukumu la Muuzaji . Akaunti yako huanza kama inasubiri mpaka biashara yako iidhinishwe. 2. Kamilisha wasifu wa biashara yako Kutoka kwenye dashibodi yako, fungua kichupo cha Biashara na ujaze: - Jina la biashara - Barua pepe ya biashara, WhatsApp na simu ya ofisi - Anwani (jiji, wilaya, kata, alama ya eneo) - URL ya tovuti (si lazima) - Namba ya usajili wa biashara (si lazima) - Namba ya kodi (si lazima) - Mwaka ulioanzishwa - Nembo (logo) na picha ya jalada - Ada ya usafirishaji ya msingi 3. Idhinishwa Msimamizi anakagua maombi yako. Unaweza kuangalia hali yako ya uthibitishaji moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye kichupo cha Biashara . <Callout type="warning" Huwezi kuorodhesha bidhaa mpaka hali ya biashara yako iwe Imeidhinishwa . </Callout 4. Anzisha duka lako Ukishaidhinishwa: - Ongeza bidhaa zako (jina, bei, hisa, kipimo, picha). - Sanidi maeneo yako ya usafirishaji na ada. - Ongeza wanachama wa timu ya usafirishaji ikiwa unapanga kutimiza agizo mwenyewe. - Weka saa zako za kazi . Orodha ya ukaguzi kwa muuzaji - [ ] Akaunti imeidhinishwa - [ ] Wasifu wa biashara umekamilika - [ ] Angalau bidhaa moja imeorodheshwa - [ ] Maeneo ya usafirishaji yamesanidiwa - [ ] Saa za kazi zimewekwa Uko tayari kuorodhesha bidhaa? Tazama Kusimamia bidhaa.

title: Kukamilisha usafirishaji & uthibitishaji wa ID
description: Mchakato wa kukabidhi usafirishaji — jinsi ya kumthibitisha mpokeaji na kuweka agizo kuwa limewasilishwa.
text: Kukamilisha usafirishaji kwa usahihi ni sehemu muhimu zaidi ya kazi yako. SokoPlus hutumia mfumo wa uthibitishaji wa njia tatu kuhakikisha kila agizo linafika kwa mtu sahihi.
